about: Customize mode: what the agent knows and can do (Settings is how the app behaves). Both apps draw the sidebar rows and each list page's explainer card from this file. The canvas frames F1-F10 are the design. explainer.href is the section's own docs page; until docs/app/manifest.json has that slug, an app links explainer.fallback (an existing page that covers it), or no link without one.

explainer.bold: A skill teaches Frog how to do one task your way.
explainer.rest: It is a short file of steps, read in full only when that task comes up. Its one-line summary rides along on every turn.

explainer.bold: A connection lets Frog reach something outside your code,
explainer.rest: like GitHub or a database, through its tools. Each tool you switch on adds a little to every turn.

explainer.bold: Rules are standing instructions Frog reads on every turn.
explainer.rest: They live in a file in your repo or your home folder, so your team shares them.

explainer.bold: Memory is what Frog has learned from working with you.
explainer.rest: It notes things on its own, keeps them on this Mac, and brings back only the few that fit the turn.

explainer.bold: An automation is a task Frog repeats without you,
explainer.rest: at a set time or when CI fails. To make one, do the task once in a conversation and say "keep doing this".
